requirements.requirement: The system must include a sponsor_credibility object in the clinical trial evaluation API response.
The system must populate sponsor_credibility.score using the output from EVAL-CT-SPONSOR-LOGIC-001.
The system must populate sponsor_credibility.classification as a discrete label derived from the credibility score (e.g., high, medium, low).
The system must include sponsor_credibility.explanation as a human-readable text explaining the score rationale.
The system must integrate sponsor credibility into the EvaluateCare facade response structure without breaking existing response fields.
The system must ensure the sponsor_credibility object is returned for every clinical trial evaluation request when sponsor data is available.
The system must return a null or explicitly marked unavailable sponsor_credibility object when sponsor data is missing.
The system must handle multiple collaborators by reflecting their influence within the explanation text.
The system must ensure the explanation text is consistent with the computed score and classification.
The system must generate explanation text that explicitly references sponsor type and funding source when available.
The system must ensure the explanation text is concise and does not exceed a predefined character limit suitable for UI display.
The system must ensure explanation text contains no fabricated data beyond what is derived from sponsor logic outputs.
The system must return a valid API response even if sponsor credibility logic fails, with sponsor_credibility marked as unavailable.
The system must log an error when sponsor credibility logic fails to produce a score.
The system must ensure the sponsor_credibility object conforms to the schema defined in EVAL-CT-SPONSOR-SCHEMA-001.
The system must ensure API response latency is not increased beyond acceptable thresholds due to sponsor credibility integration.
